proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: take N from the boundedness lemma for Rf_!, use the adjunction defining Rf^!, test the truncation of Rf^!K below a - N: boundedness gives vanishing of Rf_! of the truncation in degrees <= a - 1, the negative exts lemma gives Hom = 0 against K, so the truncation map is zero and Rf^!K vanishes below a - N (source lines 4113-4125)
